articles.description: A law to end surprise medical bills has generated millions of high-dollar payouts for doctors. Health plans are now fighting back by frequently withholding money.
articles.content: A law to end surprise medical bills has generated millions of high-dollar payouts for doctors. Health plans are now fighting back by frequently withholding money.

articles.author: Coral Davenport and Rebecca Davis O’Brien
articles.title: Trump Administration Said to Plan Rolling Back Pregnancy-Related Job Protections
articles.description: The Biden era law was meant to help women stay in the workplace, but some conservatives say rules to enact it went too far with coverage for abortion and fertility treatment.
